items.known: Found on 2026-10-11 quoting a real managed service with a reinforcement person in five campaign weeks a year. The composer takes one price per tool and period; a seat-priced tool must have exactly as many seats as people using it that period; and an annual subscription cannot change its units or have gaps without a renewal policy. So «one annual seat all year plus one monthly seat in the campaign months» cannot be expressed. Two consistent readings were quoted instead: two annual seats all year with the reinforcement spread evenly over the twelve months, and a monthly-billed account with a second seat in the campaign months. They bracket the real cost; the difference between them is about 2.4 margin points on that quote. Closed the same day. The three purchase plans of that quote now calculate as declared: one monthly seat shared (the CEO's decision), an annual seat plus a monthly one in the campaign months, and two annual seats with one idle for seven months

items.known: Found on 2026-10-11. The document prints an optional add-on from its own frozen quote, which is the right source for its price. When the add-on is a few more points of a person who is already a line of the base quote, the add-on's quote is a new line and takes the per-line platform fee and its share of the base tools again. Measured on a real add-on of eight points of one person: the fee alone was about a quarter of its cost and moved its margin from above the floor to well below it. The price printed is unaffected; the margin of such an add-on is a lower bound. Closed the same day. On that real add-on the increment removes exactly the per-line fee charged again, and its margin is back above the floor; on the second add-on of that quote the incremental cost matches the one estimated independently
